newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS posts 348 mln sfr loss for 1996.
newsitem.headline: UBS posts 348 mln sfr loss for 1996.

text.p: NOTE - The loss was expected after Union Bank of Switzerland said last November it would take a one-time charge of three billion Swiss francs to cover bad domestic loans, causing a loss for the year of about 500 million Swiss francs.
Group assets vs yr earlier 437,252 vs 386,784
"UBS reported a good operating result for 1996. Cash flow was increased by 21 percent to 4,312 million Swiss francs," it said in a statement.

"The special provision of three billion francs, announced in November 1996, for credit risks over the next few years and a charge of 120 million francs for restructuring costs in Switzerland resulted in the UBS group reporting a loss of 348 million francs for 1996, however."
Ordinary credit risk provisions of 1.4 billion also weighed on results, it said.
Excluding the special provision and restructuring charge, "group profit would have been in the region of 1.8 billion francs, seven percent more than in 1995".
